description: Source code for a mock proxy in Zephyr RTOS, handling ZBus communication, UART I/O, and message decoding.

methods.name: encoder
methods.description: Encodes a zbus channel into a byte identifier.

methods.name: decoder
methods.description: Decodes a byte identifier into a zbus channel.

methods.name: proxy_callback
methods.description: Callback function for zbus channel events, handles UART message sending.

methods.name: decode_sentence
methods.description: Decodes incoming UART data into zbus messages.

methods.name: mock_proxy_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for receiving UART data and processing it.
